hostname ix-l01
!
ip route default 203.0.113.10
!
ip access-list sec-p1 permit ip src any dest any
ike proposal ike-prop-p1 encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit lifetime 86400
ike policy ike-p1 peer any key dummy-psk-sample-ra ike-prop-p1
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-p1 esp-aes-256 esp-sha lifetime time 3600
ipsec dynamic-map CMAP-SAMPLE-10 sec-p1 pfs off ipsec-prop-p1
!
ike nat-traversal
!
ppp profile RA-SAMPLE
  authentication request chap
  authentication password example-user dummy-l2tp-user-secret-1
  authentication password sample-user dummy-l2tp-user-secret-2
  lcp pfc
  lcp acfc
  ipcp ip-compression
  ipcp provide-ip-address range 192.0.2.131 192.0.2.190
  ipcp provide-remote-dns 192.0.2.53 192.0.2.54
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample-wan
  ip address 203.0.113.9/30
  no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0.0
  ip address 192.0.2.129/25
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  ip unnumbered Loopback0.0
  ppp binding RA-SAMPLE
  tunnel mode l2tp-lns ipsec
  ipsec policy transport CMAP-SAMPLE-10
  no shutdown
!
